comment: Seed queries for the retrieval eval harness. 40 register user, 20 register scholarly. User queries are written the way a person in difficulty actually types: first person, concrete particulars, no philosophical vocabulary. Scholarly queries use the technical vocabulary on purpose, as a control that isolates the vocabulary gap. Doctrine other queries are ones where the honest answer is that the corpus has little to offer.
